name: MOST PAAGAL EVER - Rudraksh Review
description:
We had the esteemed privilege of reviewing Rudraksh. 

Rudraksh is a movie that combines technology, mythology and VFX into an elegant soufflé that smells strongly of car tires. We would best describe it as Ramayan II - Judgement day.
